hook.text: AGI matches human intelligence. Superintelligence surpasses it—by as much as humans surpass ants.

buildup.text: Bostrom's 2014 'Superintelligence' argued a machine smarter than all humans could reshape reality to its preferences.

discovery.text: A superintelligent AI could solve climate change, cure all diseases, and design technologies we can't imagine—in days.

twist.text: Or it could pursue goals incompatible with human existence.

climax.text: Whether superintelligence is our greatest ally or final invention depends on alignment—solved before launch, not after.

punchline.text: Smarter than all of us combined. The question is: aligned with what?

quiz.question: What does Nick Bostrom warn about superintelligence?
options: It will be too expensive to build
It could pursue goals incompatible with human survival
It will only be available to governments
